image_description:
## 1. Chart type
- **Flow map / migration chord-style map** over a world map.
- It shows **directed flows** between regions using curved arrows, plus **self-loops** for within-continent migration.

## 2. Layout techniques
- **Geographic layout**: regions are positioned on a world map.
- **Flow links**: curved arrows connect origin and destination regions.
- **Variable-width links**: arrow thickness appears to encode migration volume.
- **Self-loop circles**: large circular arrows around regions indicate migration within the same continent.
- No faceting or small multiples.

## 3. Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Continent / Region (e.g., North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, Africa, Oceania) | Categorical/nominal | Geographic position on map; text labels |
| Migration flow volume (in millions) | Quantitative | Arrow/flow thickness; numeric labels on flows and loops |
| Origin region | Categorical/nominal | Start point of curved arrow on map |
| Destination region | Categorical/nominal | End point / arrowhead location on map |
| Within-continent migration | Categorical/nominal relationship | Circular self-loop arrows around each region |
| Year (2017) | Temporal | Title text (“Migration in 2017”) |
